describe: The image shows an aerial view of farmland, made of four large blurred aerial-photo pieces joined into a square. The top-right piece shows green fields, dark hedgerows, a small road and a few houses. The lower-right piece shows tan and brown ploughed fields with a dark tree line. Left-side areas are smeared dark green and grey paint-like patches. Colours are green, olive, tan and brown, under even daylight with medium contrast. Every piece must stay exactly in place.
